# GenieAI

> GenieAI is an AI-powered contract drafting, review, and negotiation platform trusted by 200,000+ users to automate legal workflows across industries.

GenieAI provides autonomous legal AI solutions that help organizations streamline contract management, reduce legal costs, and accelerate deal closure. The platform serves diverse sectors including technology, energy, construction, and real estate, with tailored solutions for teams across leadership, sales, legal, HR, and procurement.
